claims.statement: TFC Optical (300394.SZ) announcement 2026-10-23: in CPO companion products it has achieved stable mass-production delivery of FAU and ELS (external laser source) products; it has long-term cooperation with leading global optical module makers and AI computing infrastructure companies; order backlog is ample.
